note: Influence and approval are gameplay starting values for 1 January 2000 (the second Laar government of Pro Patria Union, Moderates and the Reform Party, pursuing EU and NATO accession), not measured data.

interest_groups.note: Small conscript Defence Forces; NATO accession was a government priority.
Liberal market reforms of the 1990s (flat income tax, currency board) favoured business.
Largely secular society; Lutheran and Orthodox churches have limited political weight.
Represented mainly by the Country People's Union, then in opposition.
Large Russian-speaking minority, many without Estonian citizenship in 2000; represented in the Riigikogu by the Estonian United People's Party.
